s01-open.before:
properties:
  note.price:
    displayName: Price
  status:
    displayName: Status
  formula.ppu:
    displayName: Per unit
formulas:
  ppu: price / density
filters:
  and:
    - type == "rock"
views:
  - type: table
    name: Qualified
    order:
      - file.name
      - note.status
      - note.price
      - note.density
      - formula.ppu
      - file.ext
    sort:
      - property: note.price
        direction: DESC
      - property: formula.ppu
        direction: ASC
      - property: file.name
        direction: ASC
    groupBy:
      property: note.status
      direction: ASC
    summaries:
      note.price: Average
      formula.ppu: Sum
    columnSize:
      file.name: 120
      note.status: 150
      note.price: 160
  - type: cards
    name: Pics
    order:
      - file.name
      - note.status
    image: note.cover
  - type: table
    name: Bare
    order:
      - file.name
      - status
      - price
    sort:
      - property: price
        direction: DESC
    columnSize:
      status: 150
